name: EXPBG GM Tools
description:
# EXPBG GM Tools

- Garrison: put any infantry squad into a building with guard posts and indoor patrols; Random Garrison fills a whole area.
- Unit Caching: AI far from players sleeps and wakes at the same spot (Simulation or Full cache; squads Full cannot take, like Hold, Freeze, animations or static weapon gunners, fall back to Simulation).
- Intel Items: laptops, notebooks, manuals, tablets, server racks and USB drives with readable intel and downloads.
- Ambient Civilians: residents, pedestrians and traffic that react to danger, with exclusion zones.
- Ambient Destruction: damaged buildings, wrecks and debris in a zone.
- Ambient Sounds: placeable radios, TVs, crowds, war ambience and sound effects.
- Ambient Unrest: protest zones.
- Unit Scripts: hold position, freeze and ambient animations. Unit Dialog: talk to AI.
- AI Surrender: squads surrender after casualties, interrogation and intel; per-squad rules of engagement and warning shots.
- AI Global Skills: skill, aim and ammunition per faction; AI skill and rules of engagement per squad or soldier.
- Time and Weather: smooth weather transitions and time skips.
- Briefing Map: briefing boards and projectors.
- Persistent Battlefield: the battlefield is saved with the mission; reconnect support; no Game Master budget limits.
- Requires: EXPBG Audio Data (198987BE7BAC4C84).
summary: Game Master toolkit: garrisons, unit caching, intel items, ambient civilians, destruction, sounds and unrest, unit scripts, AI surrender and skills, weather and briefing map.
